title: Patent Agent and Prior USPTO Examiner Jack Kraynak Joins Solve Intelligence
summary: Jack Kraynak, a registered U.S. patent agent and prior USPTO examiner, joins Solve Intelligence to help build products for patent practitioners.
body_markdown:
We're happy to welcome Jack Kraynak to Solve Intelligence as a Legal & Product Engineer! Jack is a registered U.S. patent agent who joins us with several years of patent examination experience at the USPTO, along with licensing and assignment work at IBM. He specializes in prior art searching, claim interpretation, response drafting, and freedom-to-operate strategy. He holds a B.S. in Bioengineering, and as an undergraduate he focused on 3D bioprinting and additive manufacturing.


At Solve, Jack will help ensure our products continue to meet the needs of patent practitioners.


Please join us in welcoming Jack to the team!
